answer: Sybil resistance through stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and voting weight scales with bonded stake rather than headcount. A sybil swarm splitting into many identities gains nothing because the total stake needed to influence the tide of consensus grows quadratically with the number of clones, while an legitimate agent needs only one bond.
